messages:
maria: Opening a PR for the offline mirror + signature-checking checklist for private installs. It adds an example for mirroring apt/rpm repos to an external disk and validating signatures before the installer runs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 :eyes:
aj: nice. can you add a short SDK snippet that shows how the client falls back to cached KMS tokens when the node is isolated? we had a customer ask for that yesterday.
chris: optional: include a systemd unit example to mount the USB mirror at /mnt/repo and run a quick sha256sum check on the tarball. saves time in the installer.
sam: security note — doc should insist on GPG key fingerprint pinning and show rpm --import / verify steps. also mention offline key rotation caveats.
lin: also add a short troubleshooting section: "mirror appears valid but installer times out connecting to KMS" — list common causes (DNS, proxy, cert path).
maria: ok i'll add: - aptmirror.yaml example - rpmrepo sync script - gpg fingerprint pinning - preflight CLI snippet for the installer - SDK fallback example
aj: for the SDK fallback example, keep it tiny. something like:
```python
# redwood-py example: try network KMS, fallback to local cache
from redwood import KMSClient
client = KMSClient(endpoint="https://kms.prod.redwood.example")
try:
    secret = client.get_secret("service-key")
except ConnectionError:
    # offline fallback to cached token path
    secret = client.get_secret_cached("/var/lib/redwood/kms-cache")
print(secret)
```
chris: i'll add the systemd mount + checksum snippet:
```ini
[Unit]
Description=Mount offline repo
After=local-fs.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/bin/mkdir -p /mnt/repo && /bin/mount /dev/disk/by-label/REDWOOD_REPO /mnt/repo
ExecStartPost=/usr/bin/sha256sum -c /mnt/repo/manifest.sha256
RemainAfterExit=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```
sam: include the exact command examples for verifying keys: for apt: `gpg --import /mnt/repo/keys/redwood.asc` then `apt-key add` is deprecated — show `signed-by` example in sources.list. for rpm: `rpm --import /mnt/repo/keys/redwood.pub` and `gpgcheck=1`.
maria: placing a draft in the PR now with those snippets. notes: - kept the preflight command minimal: `redwood-installer preflight --mirror /mnt/repo --verify-signatures` - added link to our offline mirror sync utility (internal) - added caveat about long key rotation windows for HSM-backed KMS
lin: tiny wording nit: change "verify-signatures" to "verify-repo-signatures" to be explicit.
maria: done. pushing update.
devops-bot: deploy-check: docs PR 842 queued for build, lint will run in ~3m. :gear:
aj: post-lint checklist for reviewers: 1) run preflight locally 2) try SDK fallback snippet with deliberate network block 3) confirm wording for "pinned fingerprint" is prescriptive, not optional
chris: FYI I added an alternate mirror strategy: nginx serving the repo with client certs for internal airgapped sites. left it as an appendix.
sam: approved the security phrasing, asked maria to add one sentence about limiting USB access on regulated installs.
maria: thanks — PR updated with those minor edits. tagging reviewers: @aj @chris @sam @lin. can someone do a quick manual verify later today? :pray:
aj: I'll run the preflight steps in my environment at 16:00 PT and post results here.
maria: awesome. CI + one manual run should be enough to merge after any doc fixes. closing loop after aj posts results. :+1:
